SSO users: Amazon Cognito, Supabase Auth and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform bill SAML/OIDC per SSO user, not per connection (first 50 free, then $0.015 per SSO user a month). Their SSO results here assume 200 SSO users per connection (5 connections = 1,000 SSO users). See how 1,000 or 2,000 per connection changes the result or set your own. B2B: every SSO result assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection (members = its SSO users, 200 by default). Published org caps and fees are applied, e.g. Clerk’s $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on above 20 members or 100 orgs, Auth0 Free’s 5-org cap, Descope $1/tenant over 35; plans over a cap are left out. All org terms · set your org count. * Logto Pro bills access tokens, not MAU (50k tokens included, then $0.08 per 100) — the figure is base fee only; token overage depends on your usage. “Auth0 wants $800/month”? Funded startups may get year 1 free, then the cliff

Auth0 for Startups (auth0.com/startups, read 2026-10-31) gives eligible startups one year of the B2B Professional plan free, up to 100,000 MAU, with 5 Enterprise Connections, Enterprise MFA and inbound SCIM. Eligibility (Auth0’s words): venture-backed with less than $5M in funding; less than $1M in annual recurring revenue; less than two years from the date of incorporation; not valid for existing paid Auth0/Okta customers or past program members. When the 12 months end, list price applies: B2B Professional with 3 SSO connections is $800/mo at 1,000 MAU, $1,500/mo at 5,000 MAU, $2,400/mo at 10,000 MAU; above 10,000 MAU Auth0 publishes no B2B Professional price (contact sales). Not eligible? Nothing changes: list prices apply from month 1. Our rankings always use list prices.

Auth0

Free to 25k MAU with 1 Enterprise Connection, Self-Service SSO and inbound SCIM. B2C Essentials runs $35 (500 MAU) → $700 (10k) → $3,500 (50k)/mo; B2C Professional $240 → $1,600 (10k) → $3,200 (20k). B2B Essentials $150 (500) → $2,100 (10k) → $3,800 (20k) with 3 SSO connections; B2B Professional $800 → $2,400 (10k) with 5. Extra SSO connections $100/mo. Yearly = 11× monthly. Above those tiers: Enterprise, contact sales.

Source: auth0.com/pricing · 2026-10-31

Logto

Free: 50k MAU / 50k tokens. Pro from $24/mo: unlimited MAU, 50k tokens then $0.08 per 100 extra. Enterprise SSO add-on $48/connector. MFA add-on $48. Organizations add-on $48.

Source: logto.io/pricing · 2026-10-31
